rating.comment: Card rating 40-99. Dev mapping from the FPL dataset price (tenths of £m): rating = 48 + 0.9 × (price − 40), capped at 99.

starter.comment: Five players in squad shape, all from one tier, one guaranteed stronger card (one tier up).

swap.comment: Swap and compensation packs: one player of the same rarity as the card replaced, any position.
